goal: Continue Codex Widget product development through repeated vibe-iterate sprints until the categorized dogfooding backlog is closed.
clarification: The product owner clarified that the prior /goal directive was not satisfied by completing the Iteration 3 sprint set. The durable project state must remain active and continue opening new iterations/sprints for remaining product areas.
newUserRequests: Treat /goal as a repeated vibe-iterate workflow for all remaining tasks, not a one-off sprint or single iteration.

Close the previously categorized task groups that remain incomplete: UI polish, session/tab behavior, Agent widget awareness, artifact rendering/version UX, Vision streaming/voice foundations, PTY popup behavior, mascot/persona behavior, and provider/runtime history gaps.
Keep architecture, project structure, reuse, and long-term extensibility in scope whenever new features are added.
Preserve daemon ownership of sessions, messages, app-server runtime, provider snapshots, artifacts, activity logs, and SQLite/blob-backed product state.
Use taste-skill guidance for visible widget UI improvements while preserving the desktop-widget interaction model.
carryoverSummary: Iteration 3 completed the storage/session/artifact/Vision foundations but left several user-facing backlog areas partial or unimplemented.

Visible durable sessions, internal tabs, trash, artifacts, and Vision streaming now exist, but deeper app-server thread rebinding, richer artifact rendering/version UI, and provider snapshot history remain open.
The renderer has several dogfooding UI defects: resize hit areas, minimum-width select overlap, tab/session affordance polish, More action menu alignment, and branch/session feedback.
Agent mode needs explicit widget capability context so it can answer questions about its own controls, modes, PTY, Vision, DOM, settings, and limitations.
Vision should progress toward interactive screen-sharing and later voice prompt input while keeping user consent, resource limits, and retention boundaries explicit.
PTY currently works as an internal terminal viewport, but the intended separate popup window and product use-case explanation are not complete.
Mascot support has status-aware animation and seeded metadata, but the default dog persona/tone behavior and future module platform boundary need another sprint.
openRisks: The external goal tracker was prematurely marked complete; the durable project state now records this correction, but the tool status cannot be reverted in this session.
Codex app-server protocol remains experimental; keep exec fallback and avoid assuming durable thread resume until explicitly implemented.
Vision screen streaming needs dogfooding for CPU, memory, cadence, and privacy/retention behavior.
Artifact version preservation must avoid data loss while keeping blob storage growth bounded.
Future custom theme/mascot/module platform work should not leak into current sprint scope beyond data-boundary preparation.
